title: SlurmAPIResource
description: SLURM cluster resource using SLURM REST API v0.0.40

name.description: Human-readable name for this resource instance

storage.description: Reference to storage configuration key in available_storage

user_authentication.description: Reference to authentication configuration key in available_user_authentication

parameter_mapping.description: Maps generic parameter names to SLURM-specific names (e.g., num_cpus -> cpus_per_task)

cpu_partition.description: SLURM partition name for CPU jobs

gpu_partition.description: SLURM partition name for GPU jobs

root_url.description: Base URL for SLURM REST API (e.g., 'https://slurm.example.com/api')

api_token.description: API token for SLURM REST API authentication

health_check_url.description: URL for health check endpoint. When present, the resource is health-checked before each selection.

capabilities.description: Hardware capabilities used by the intelligent resource selector to filter ineligible resources. Omit this section to exclude the resource from intelligent selection (it will still be used as main_resource fallback).

gpu_enabled.description: Whether this resource has GPU support

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs that can be requested per job

max_memory_mb.description: Maximum memory per job in MB (matches the memory_mb resource option)

max_time_minutes.description: Maximum walltime per job in minutes (matches the time_limit_min resource option)

max_gpus.description: Maximum GPUs per job (0 = no GPU support)

max_concurrent_jobs.description: Soft concurrent-job ceiling used to calculate utilization fraction for scoring. Omit to disable utilization scoring for this resource.

selection_criteria.description: Scoring hints used by the intelligent resource selector to rank eligible resources.

priority.description: Base priority score (0-100). Higher values make this resource preferred when all else is equal.

cost_per_core_hour.description: Relative cost metric per core-hour. Lower values are preferred for cost-optimised routing.

preferred_for_job_types.description: Job type keys (matching available_job_types keys) that this resource is preferred for. Matching jobs receive a bonus score.
